title: Weighted mean of every earlier content under exponentiated match scores
summary: Every symbol leaves an address vector and a content vector in a growing list. At each position a probe vector is matched against every listed address by a scaled dot product, the matches are exponentiated and divided by their sum, and the result weights the listed contents. A position-wise two-layer map with a residual path follows.
core_idea: Read a growing list of earlier contents by weights proportional to the exponential of scaled probe-address dot products, normalized over the whole list.

state.name: P
state.meaning: List of (address, content) pairs, one appended per symbol read so far; it grows with the position t.

update.name: append
update.latex: a_t = W_a z_t,\; c_t = W_c z_t,\; P_t = P_{t-1} \cup \{(a_t, c_t)\}
update.plain: a_t = W_a z_t and c_t = W_c z_t, where z_t = E[x_t] + p_t is the embedding plus a learned vector for position t; append the pair (a_t, c_t) to the list

readout.name: weights
readout.plain: omega_(t,i) = exp(b_t . a_i / sqrt(d)) for i = 1..t, with probe b_t = W_b z_t

readout.name: mean
readout.plain: y_t = sum_i omega_(t,i) c_i / sum_j omega_(t,j)

readout.name: position-wise map
readout.latex: r_t = z_t + W_o y_t,\; o_t = r_t + W_2\,\mathrm{relu}(W_1 r_t)
readout.plain: r_t = z_t + W_o y_t; o_t = r_t + W_2 relu(W_1 r_t); next symbol scores O o_t

learning.description: Every matrix and offset is learned by gradient descent on the cross-entropy of the next symbol over a training corpus, with backpropagation through the whole sequence.
learning.few_shot_argument: No structure for few examples; the card states 1000 training sequences for recall of 4 pairs.

complexity.total_sequence: Theta(n^2 d + n d^2 + n d V)
complexity.constants_notes: At position t the probe is matched against t addresses and t contents are averaged, so the total is quadratic in n; the list holds 2 d numbers per symbol.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Gradient descent with no structure for few examples.

prediction.statement: From random weights, 1000 training sequences of 4 pairs over 16 symbols give recall accuracy 0.99.

capabilities.prediction: Exact recall at any K with hand-set weights, because every pair stays in the list and a large score scale makes the weights a near point mass on the matching address.

capabilities.task: copy a string after a separator
capabilities.prediction: Exact copying at any length with position vectors that let a probe match the position L back.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: Recall accuracy drops below 0.9 at K = 64 with hand-set weights and a large score scale.
The counted operations grow slower than quadratically in n.

toy_example.description: Three listed pairs and one normalized exponential read.
toy_example.python:
import json, math
A = [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 1.0]]
Cv = [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0], [2.0, 2.0]]
b = [2.0, 0.0]
w = [math.exp((b[0] * a[0] + b[1] * a[1]) / math.sqrt(2.0)) for a in A]
Z = sum(w)
y = [sum(w[i] * Cv[i][j] for i in range(3)) / Z for j in range(2)]
print(json.dumps({"weights": [round(v / Z, 6) for v in w], "read": [round(v, 6) for v in y]}))
